title: New Releases 2026 – Curve Dental
markdown:
[Skip to main content](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#main-content) * * * **Description** This quick guide contains all the 2026 new releases for Curve Hero and Curve GRO. **About** These tables are displayed by module, and are not ordered by release date. Additional tables will be added as releases are done in other modules. **Contents** - [Section 1](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#1) \- Insights - [Section 2](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#2) \- Charting - [Section 3](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#3) \- Curve Pay - [Section 4](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#4) \- Insurance - [Section 5](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#5) \- Curve GRO - [Section 6](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51509556722451-New-Releases-2026#6) \- Claims - Insights - BI/Reporting** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Adjusted Production**\- Collection and Production reports have the ability to enable the adjusted production to display or to not display. | **Quick Guide** \- Demonstrated on [Understanding the Balance Collection Summary Report](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/48387531970323-Understanding-the-Balance-Collection-Summary-Report) | | **Production Collection Report** \- Use these reports and corresponding dashboards to track how much of the production has been collected, and how much is remaining to be collected. | **Quick Guides** \- [Adding and Reviewing the Template Balance Collection Reports in Curve Insights](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49059052949779-Adding-and-Reviewing-the-Template-Balance-Collection-Reports-in-Curve-Insights)
[Understanding the Balance Collection Summary Report](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/48387531970323-Understanding-the-Balance-Collection-Summary-Report)
**Video -** [Breaking Down the Balance Collection Reports in Insights](https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/recording/7857804337370954498) | | **Referral Report**\- Use this report to track how many patients by provider and production have come from various referrals. | **Quick Guide** \- [Creating and Reviewing the Referral Dashboard and Report Templates in Curve Insights](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49094796707091-Creating-and-Reviewing-the-Referral-Dashboard-and-Report-Templates-in-Curve-Insights) | **Section 2 - Charting** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Supernumerary Teeth** \- Supernumerary teeth can be marked in treatment plans, appointments, and invoices. | **Quick Guide** \- [Charting Supernumerary Teeth](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49464872557587-Charting-Supernumerary-Teeth)
[Adding a Supernumerary Tooth on the Charting Odontogram](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47669435269651-Adding-a-Supernumerary-Tooth-on-the-Charting-Odontogram) | | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | Procedure Multi-Select\- Rearrange multiple procedures to a different visit or treatment plan card. | **Quick Guide**- [Understanding the Treatment Plan Multi-Select Function](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/54900761241107-Understanding-the-Treatment-Plan-Multi-Select-Function)
**Video** \- [Setting up Treatment Plans](https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/recording/2803655053381858564) | | **Feature** | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Charting Bridges and Partials with Shortcut Buttons**\- Bridges and Partials can now be charted with Shortcut buttons. They can also be added with Charting +. | **Quick Guide**- | **Section 3 - Curve Pay** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Buy Now Pay Later -** The responsible party can pay through a Payment Request through a third party financing option, either Affirm or Klarna. | **Quick Guide** \- [Reviewing How to Set Up and Use Klarna and/or Affirm](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/48848992049683-Reviewing-How-to-Set-Up-and-Use-Klarna-and-or-Affirm) | | **Payment Request Updated Amount** \- When a Payment Request is sent, it will show the current outstanding balance on the account, whether that amount is the same as when the request was first sent, or if a payment has been made since the initial send. | | | **Link autofill payment method**\- Curve Pay uses _Link_ to securely fill the responsible party's payment method, which saves the time it takes to manually add the card information. | **Quick Guide** \- [Reviewing the Link Payment Service in Curve Pay](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49777930979987-Reviewing-the-Link-Payment-Service-in-Curve-Pay) | | **Bulk Payment Request** \- Payment Requests can be sent to all the responsible parties with an outstanding balance. | **Quick Guide** \- [Creating and Sending a Bulk Payment Request](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49072259208339-Creating-and-Sending-a-Bulk-Payment-Request) | | **Deposit Refunds**\- A credit refund can now be done with Curve Pay. | **Quick Guide** \- [Refunding a Curve Pay Credit](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51410110124947-Refunding-a-Curve-Pay-Credit) | | **Payment Disputes**\- Payment disputes will display in the payment row of the Billing module, and will automatically show refunded if the dispute is approved. | **Quick Guide -** [Understanding How Curve Pay Payment Disputes Display in the Billing Module](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/52641632186387-Understanding-How-Curve-Pay-Payment-Disputes-Display-in-the-Billing-Module) | | **Statements with Payment Requests** \- Payment Requests will be sent with a more detailed breakdown of what is owed, and will include a statement. | **Quick Guide** \- [Reviewing Itemized Billing Information on Curve Pay Statements and Payment Requests](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/55345729659411-Reviewing-Itemized-Billing-Information-on-Curve-Pay-Statements-and-Payment-Requests) | **Section 4 - Insurance** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Do Not Send to Insurance** \- A procedure code can be set to _Do Not Send to Insurance_ in Administration, or when creating a single claim. | **Quick Guide**- [Marking a Code as Do Not Send to Insurance](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50066938826515-Marking-a-Code-as-Do-Not-Send-To-Insurance) | | | | | --- | --- | | **Feature** | **Support Center Resources** | | **Control Claim Creation** \- This feature allows an insurance plan to be set to allow all claim types, only manual, only electronic, or to be set to not allow claim creation at all. | **Quick Guide -** [Control Claim Creation Options](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/55712423397907-Control-Claim-Creation-Options) | **Section 5 - Curve GRO** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Automatic Clinic Hours Text Reply -** Offices with Curve GRO can set up an automatic response to patients that have contacted their office before or after clinic hours. | **Quick Guide** \- [Reviewing the Text Reply Feature in Curve GRO](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49274794025875-Reviewing-the-Text-Reply-Feature-in-Curve-GRO) | | **Birthday Campaign**-A birthday message can be sent automatically on your patients' birthdays. | **Quick Guide** \- [Creating a Birthday Email Template and Text Message Template](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51388254935443-Creating-a-Birthday-Email-Template-and-Text-Message-Template)
[Creating a Birthday Campaign in Curve GRO](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51126372011539-Creating-a-Birthday-Campaign-in-Curve-GRO) | | **Deny List Management**\- A list of patients numbers will be listed in the Deny List in Curve GRO. These are numbers that are not delivering or receiving messages through LiveText. | **Quick Guide**\- [Reviewing the Deny List Section in Curve GRO](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/53723686942227-Reviewing-the-Deny-List-Section-in-Curve-GRO) | **Section 6 - Claims** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Saved Service Location** _**-**_ Set service locations in Administration to display on claims. These can be set as a default location, or select the address in the Advanced Claim window. | **Quick Guide -** [Understanding Saved Service Locations](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/53298824341651--Upcoming-Release-Understanding-Saved-Service-Locations) | | **Automatically Close Claim -** Claims can be set to be automatically closed upon the insurance payment being added. | **Quick Guide -** [Understanding the Auto Close Claim Feature](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49802080071187-Understanding-the-Auto-Claim-Close-Feature) | **Section 7 - Eligibility+** | **Feature** | **Support Center Resources** | | --- | --- | | **Customizable Downgrade Feature**-Set customized downgrade rules in Administration to allow specific downgrades. | **Quick Guide -** [Understanding Eligibility+ Downgrade Feature](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51822772287763-Understanding-Eligibility-Downgrade-Feature) | **Section 8 - Curve Care+** | **Feature** | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Curve Care+**\- Utilize Voice AI for clinical notes, Charting, and Perio Charting. | **Quick Guides -** [Overview of the Curve Care+ AI Suite Landing Page](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/50609443817875-Overview-of-the-Curve-Care-AI-Suite-Landing-Page)

**Video -** [Curve AI Voice Activated Charting](https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/recording/6920619111589882628) | | **Perio+**-Create a perio chart with voice AI, including conditions. | **Quick Guide -** [Overview of the Curve Care+ AI Perio Charting](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/51186122901523-Overview-of-the-Curve-Care-AI-Perio-Charting)

These can be quickly selected when batching a claim. | **Quick Guide** \- [Understanding Saved Service Locations](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/53298824341651-Understanding-Saved-Service-Locations) | | **Feature** | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Merge Carriers** \- Insurance carriers can be merged to eliminate duplicates. | **Quick Guide** \- [Understanding How to Merge Carriers](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/55636857944723-Understanding-How-To-Merge-Carriers) | **Section 11 - Forms** | Feature | Support Center Resources | | --- | --- | | **Form Frequency**\- Set individual forms to be assigned automatically to new patients and on a scheduled frequency to existing patients. | [Using the Forms Frequency Feature](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/49301206473619--New-Release-Using-the-Forms-Frequency-Feature) | | **Form Packets** \- Bundle multiple forms into packets that are accessible in the forms list so they can be selected and assigned to patients. | [Understanding Form Packets](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/54351162250643--Upcoming-Release-Understanding-Form-Packets) | **Section 12 - RCM** | RCM | **Support Center Resources** | | --- | --- | | **RCM Claims** \- Send and track claims in the upgraded RCM module. | **Quick Guides** \- [Overview of the Curve RCM Claims Page](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/52546918017171-Overview-of-the-Curve-RCM-Claims-Page)
[Overview of the RCM Page - CA](https://curvedental.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/53882343420435-Overview-of-the-Curve-RCM-Claims-Page-CA-Offices)
